boundary_correction.conclusion: The final-signal purge removed 24 cross-boundary or late-label trades; the negative fixed-horizon Alpha and the single positive year are unchanged.

interpretation: With the history-truncation fix and the training-boundary purge enforced, the exact legacy multiscale pool still produced 1245 independent executable candidates; the prior 202-trade simplified representation remains invalid as a substitute.

The boundary-corrected ledger retains a material right tail (483 paths above 20 percent MFE, 117 above 50 percent, 23 above 100 percent), but fixed-40-day Alpha is negative overall, positive in only 2020 among seven years, and negative or statistically negligible in every market-outcome bucket.
Exit tuning cannot repair the negative fixed-horizon selection Alpha. The pool remains useful as a broad candidate generator, but its default executable status is not promoted to a complete strategy.
The corrected v2 run does not change the v1 decision; the earlier boundary exposure did not create the negative result.
stopped_variants: test-period or market-regime selection from these results
next_action: Keep the legacy multiscale flag pool as a candidate source only. Any new trade rule must first audit the detector's scale and setup-stage composition on training candidates and register one structural entry hypothesis that explains the negative bulk while preserving right-tail recall.
